name: Berberis vulgaris extract
description: Berberis vulgaris extract (CAS 84649-92-3 ), commonly known as Barberry extract, is a standardized botanical extract derived from the fruit, root, and bark of the barberry shrub. It delivers a concentrated source of berberine and other alkaloids alongside natural organic acids. This versatile extract positions itself as a functional ingredient across food, pharmaceutical, and personal care markets. In food and beverage formulations, it contributes tart, fruity flavoring to confectionery and functional beverages. Nutraceutical manufacturers incorporate it into capsule and tablet formats targeting metabolic and digestive health positioning. It is often preferred in dietary supplements where natural acidulants are chosen over synthetic alternatives. In cosmetic formulations, the extract is used in serums and topical creams where antioxidant activity supports anti-aging and skin-tone product claims. Pharmaceutical producers also source standardized grades for inclusion in herbal medicinal products. These medicinal products require documented berberine content to ensure efficacy and safety. Berberis vulgaris extract is supplied as a dry powder or as a liquid extract, with dry forms being the most common for supplement applications. Standardized grades specifying berberine content, typically ranging from 5 percent to 98 percent, are available to meet formulator and QA requirements. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are offered depending on the intended application. The material is processed to meet rigorous quality benchmarks and regional regulatory frameworks. This ensures that the final product maintains the integrity required for high-end pharmaceutical and personal care manufacturing processes.
